resources.string: Check the text before you tap
Read how Veritxt handles your information before you start.
Only the SMS text you paste, share, or allow it to receive.
On this phone only. Veritxt has no internet permission, so your messages are never sent anywhere.
Message text is never saved. Veritxt keeps only your settings and the fact that you agreed to this notice. Clearing local data removes them.
You can check messages by pasting or sharing them. Reading new SMS needs your permission, and you can turn it off anytime.

Under the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (Republic Act No. 10173), you have the right to be informed, to object, to access, and to have your data corrected or erased. Because Veritxt stores no messages, only the settings on your phone can be accessed or erased.

Veritxt never blocks, deletes, or changes your SMS. It can miss scams or flag real messages, so always double-check.

Only your privacy-notice agreement, onboarding, incoming-SMS choice, and display and language settings are saved. No scan history or raw messages are kept. The app has no internet permission.
Android treats SMS access as a restricted permission and may refuse it. Force-stopping the app pauses incoming checks until you open it again.

When a new SMS arrives, Veritxt checks its text on this phone and then discards it. If the text looks like a scam, Veritxt warns you. Without a model, it asks whether you want to check the text instead. It won\'t read your inbox or change messages. Android may refuse this restricted permission. Notifications are a separate choice.
SMS permission granted. Veritxt will check new texts as they arrive.
SMS permission was not granted. You can still paste or share messages, or allow it later in Android settings.
This clears your privacy agreement, consent and display preferences, and current checking session. You\'ll see the privacy notice again. Android permissions remain under system settings.
Veritxt can only warn you about a new text if these are all OK. Fix anything marked below.
Not granted. Turn on “When a new SMS arrives” in Settings, or allow SMS in Android settings.
Off. Turn it on in Settings.
Blocked or muted. Allow notifications for Veritxt.
Android may stop Veritxt in the background. Set Veritxt to “Unrestricted” or “Don\'t optimize”.
Settings → Apps → Manage apps → Veritxt → turn on Autostart. Also set Battery saver to “No restrictions”.
Settings → Battery → App battery management (or More settings) → Veritxt → allow Background activity and Auto launch.
Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management → Veritxt → Allow. Also turn on Veritxt in i Manager → App manager → Autostart.
Settings → Battery → App launch → Veritxt → choose Manage manually and turn on Auto-launch and Run in background.
Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → make sure Veritxt is not in Sleeping or Deep sleeping apps.
Look for Autostart or Background activity in your battery settings and allow Veritxt.
If you force-stop Veritxt, Android won\'t deliver new texts to it until you open the app again.
On Android 13 and newer, apps installed from an APK may need extra approval: open App info → ⋮ (top right) → Allow restricted settings, then turn on SMS again.
Chat messages in Google Messages or Samsung Messages aren\'t SMS, so Veritxt never sees them. Copy and paste them instead.

The score is experimental, not a verified probability or chance of fraud. Research performance is unverified. No phishing detected does not establish that a message is safe. Verify requests through an official app, website entered independently, or a phone number you already know.

Unable to assess means there is no usable model word outside links or numbers, or the input is blank or obvious keyboard mashing. It can also occur for meaningful words this model does not know. Short messages are allowed; no minimum word count is required.
Model score: %1$s on a scale from 0 to 1. It is not a probability or a chance of fraud.
Texts scoring above %1$s are shown as %2$s.
Texts scoring %1$s or more are shown as %2$s.
The score is rounded for display; the decision uses the exact score.
Phone Master → Auto-start management → turn on Veritxt. Also Settings → Battery → App battery saver → Veritxt → No restrictions.
